items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: "Lips" Page who had a son of 15 years old, was remarried with a school teacher, Elysabeth. They invited us for dinner and we enjoyed being with them.

ctx.x: Charlie Shavers was leading the other group at the Metropole and the joint was jumping every night. Red featured a song called "Kiss the Baby" and any fellow that was with a woman, Red would ask if she was the baby. If the fellow said yes, then Red would tell him to kiss the baby and he would insist until the fellow kissed the woman. He had me kissing Lily in public at least twice every time we went to the place. Another thing he would do was when a musician came into the bar, that he knew, and he knew many, Red…

"Lips" Page who had a son of 15 years old, was remarried with a school teacher, Elysabeth. They invited us for dinner and we enjoyed being with them. Lips was a natural born joker and terrific company. We stayed late and told him that we wanted to get back to our hotel and wanted to look for a cab. He said that it was not necessary. He would take us back as he had a big new model Cadillac but had to go in the street to look for someone who could drive it. We didn't dig it. Why couldn't he drive it himself? He…

Lily did not like the city of New York very much. She thought that the hotels and also the streets were dirty, that people were upset with money and talked about it all the time, that Americans were very rude. She couldn't stand racism and so was partial with white Americans. But she loved my friends and the jazz scene.
